title: Developing Skills
statementMd:
Petya loves computer games. Finally a game that he's been waiting for so long came out!

The main character of this game has $*n*$ different skills, each of which is characterized by an integer $*a*_{*i*}$ from 0 to 100. The higher the number $*a*_{*i*}$ is, the higher is the $*i*$-th skill of the character. The total rating of the character is calculated as the sum of the values ​​of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e2dcd02b35f0f5420e94c575edfd8c59edc9fca.png) for all $*i*$ from 1 to $*n*$. The expression $⌊ *x*⌋$ denotes the result of rounding the number $*x*$ *down* to the nearest integer.

At the beginning of the game Petya got $*k*$ improvement units as a bonus that he can use to increase the skills of his character and his total rating. One improvement unit can increase any skill of Petya's character by exactly one. For example, if $*a*_{4} = 46$, after using one imporvement unit to this skill, it becomes equal to 47. A hero's skill cannot rise higher more than 100. Thus, it is permissible that some of the units will remain unused.

Your task is to determine the optimal way of using the improvement units so as to maximize the overall rating of the character. It is not necessary to use all the improvement units.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two positive integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{7}$) — the number of skills of the character and the number of units of improvements at Petya's disposal.

The second line of the input contains a sequence of $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ characterizes the level of the $*i*$-th skill of the character.

## Output

The first line of the output should contain a single non-negative integer — the maximum total rating of the character that Petya can get using $*k*$ or less improvement units.

## Note

In the first test case the optimal strategy is as follows. Petya has to improve the first skill to 10 by spending 3 improvement units, and the second skill to 10, by spending one improvement unit. Thus, Petya spends all his improvement units and the total rating of the character becomes equal to $*lfloor* *frac*{100}{10} *rfloor* +  *lfloor* *frac*{100}{10} *rfloor* = 10 + 10 =$ 20.

In the second test the optimal strategy for Petya is to improve the first skill to 20 (by spending 3 improvement units) and to improve the third skill to 20 (in this case by spending 1 improvement units). Thus, Petya is left with 4 improvement units and he will be able to increase the second skill to 19 (which does not change the overall rating, so Petya does not necessarily have to do it). Therefore, the highest possible total rating in this example is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ccaa4e1e435ea3a339c322e03a32de69d214a257.png).

In the third test case the optimal strategy for Petya is to increase the first skill to 100 by spending 1 improvement unit. Thereafter, both skills of the character will be equal to 100, so Petya will not be able to spend the remaining improvement unit. So the answer is equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b246630ca7d1b95b91970759bd8455cb3e930bf9.png).
statementZhMd:
Petya 喜欢电脑游戏。终于，一款他期待已久的游戏发布了！

这款游戏的主角拥有 $*n*$ 项不同的技能，每项技能都由一个介于 0 和 100 之间的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示。$*a*_{*i*}$ 的值越大，角色的第 $*i*$ 项技能就越强。角色的总评分等于对所有从 1 到 $*n*$ 的 $*i*$，将 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e2dcd02b35f0f5420e94c575edfd8c59edc9fca.png) 的值求和。表达式 $⌊ *x*⌋$ 表示将数 $*x*$ 向下取整到最接近的整数所得的结果。

游戏开始时，Petya 获得了 $*k*$ 个强化单位作为奖励，他可以使用这些单位来提升角色的技能和总评分。一个强化单位可以将 Petya 角色的任意一项技能提高恰好 1 点。例如，如果 $*a*_{4} = 46$，使用一个强化单位提升这项技能后，它将变为 47。角色的技能不能超过 100。因此，可以有一部分强化单位不被使用。

你的任务是确定使用强化单位的最优方案，使角色的总评分最大化。不必使用所有强化单位。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个正整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{7}$）——角色的技能数量以及 Petya 拥有的强化单位数量。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示角色的第 $*i*$ 项技能等级。

## 输出格式

输出一行，包含一个非负整数——Petya 使用不超过 $*k*$ 个强化单位后能够获得的最大角色总评分。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，最优策略如下：Petya 花费 3 个强化单位将第一项技能提升到 10，并花费 1 个强化单位将第二项技能提升到 10。因此，Petya 用完了所有强化单位，角色的总评分变为 $*lfloor* *frac*{100}{10} *rfloor* +  *lfloor* *frac*{100}{10} *rfloor* = 10 + 10 =$ 20。

在第二个测试用例中，Petya 的最优策略是将第一项技能提升到 20（花费 3 个强化单位），并将第三项技能提升到 20（此时花费 1 个强化单位）。这样，Petya 还剩下 4 个强化单位，他可以将第二项技能提升到 19（但这不会改变总评分，因此 Petya 不一定要这样做）。所以，该示例中可能获得的最高总评分是 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ccaa4e1e435ea3a339c322e03a32de69d214a257.png)。

在第三个测试用例中，Petya 的最优策略是花费 1 个强化单位将第一项技能提升到 100。此后，角色的两项技能都等于 100，因此 Petya 无法使用剩下的那个强化单位。所以答案等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b246630ca7d1b95b91970759bd8455cb3e930bf9.png)。
